scope_note: A curated, non-exhaustive directory of official Pakistani and international sources that publish technology-governance rules, institutions, indicators, or comparable metrics relevant to Pakistan.

sources.title: Telecom Indicators
sources.what_it_covers: Mobile, broadband, telecom subscriber, penetration, traffic, and related sector indicators.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Direct national telecom-sector coverage.
sources.limitations: Values are rendered in interactive charts. Preserve each indicator's reference date and do not treat subscriptions as unique people.

sources.title: Annual Reports
sources.what_it_covers: Telecom subscribers, investment, revenue, infrastructure, regulation, and sector developments.
sources.pakistan_coverage: National telecom-sector reporting with an archive beginning in 2000–01.
sources.limitations: Fiscal and reporting periods vary, and reports consolidate several underlying sources.

sources.title: Cellular Mobile Quality of Service Surveys
sources.what_it_covers: Mobile network performance by operator across selected cities, roads, railways, Azad Jammu and Kashmir, and Gilgit-Baltistan.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Selected tested locations and routes within Pakistan-administered territory.
sources.limitations: Survey geography and tested routes change between releases, so results are not a uniform national panel.

sources.title: Fixed Broadband Quality of Service Surveys
sources.what_it_covers: Internet service provider performance and compliance with selected quality-of-service indicators.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Selected providers and surveyed locations in Pakistan.
sources.limitations: The survey sample is not necessarily a census of every provider, package, location, or subscriber.

sources.title: Cyber Security Annual Reports
sources.what_it_covers: Telecom-sector cybersecurity governance, audits, capacity building, and regulatory initiatives.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan's regulated telecom sector.
sources.limitations: Telecom-sector governance reporting is not a national census of cyber incidents, losses, or harms.

sources.title: Technology Policies
sources.publisher: Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication
sources.what_it_covers: Artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, cloud-first, broadband, Digital Pakistan, data governance, and related policy documents.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Federal policy documents and drafts published by the ministry.
sources.limitations: The catalogue mixes drafts and approved policies. Confirm each document's status before relying on it.

sources.title: Publications
sources.publisher: Ministry of Information Technology and Telecommunication
sources.what_it_covers: Laws, progress reports, gender-gap studies, strategies, and implementation material.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Federal technology-sector publications.
sources.limitations: Document types and evidence standards vary; the catalogue is not itself evidence that every programme remains active.

sources.title: Central Dashboard
sources.what_it_covers: Federal digitization projects, e-office implementations, applications, portals, and programme status.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Federal-government digitization portfolio.
sources.limitations: Administrative counts appear self-reported, and project dates may describe historical milestones rather than current performance.

sources.title: Household Integrated Economic Survey
sources.what_it_covers: Household and individual computer, internet, mobile ownership and use, digital skills, and socioeconomic breakdowns.
sources.pakistan_coverage: National household survey with rural, urban, gender, and socioeconomic detail.
sources.limitations: These are survey estimates. Compare questionnaires, weights, coverage, and methodology before making trend claims.

sources.title: Pakistan Social and Living Standards Measurement Survey
sources.what_it_covers: Provincial and district ICT access, mobile ownership, internet use, and ICT skills.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Provincial and district-level household evidence.
sources.limitations: Display the reference year and geographic representativeness; different rounds may not support every comparison.

sources.title: Payment Systems Quarterly Reviews
sources.what_it_covers: Raast, cards, applications, wallets, retail-payment volume and value, and digital-channel adoption.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan's regulated payment and banking systems.
sources.limitations: The reviews exclude cash outside the banking system. Preserve fiscal-quarter definitions and provisional or revised flags.

sources.title: Branchless Banking Newsletters
sources.what_it_covers: Accounts, active accounts, agents, transactions, transaction value, gender, and province.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan's regulated branchless-banking market.
sources.limitations: Accounts are not unique people; retain the report's definition of an active account.

sources.title: EasyData
sources.what_it_covers: Searchable economic and financial time series, including selected digital-finance and payments series.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan monetary, financial, banking, and payments data.
sources.limitations: This is a broad macroeconomic portal. Cite the exact series definition, unit, frequency, and source. The page opened in web review but returned HTTP 404 to the automated link checker.

sources.title: Pakistan Economic Survey 2025–26
sources.what_it_covers: The information-technology and telecom chapter covers IT exports, freelancers, penetration, investment, and revenue.
sources.pakistan_coverage: National economic reporting.
sources.limitations: Figures may use fiscal-year, July–March, provisional, estimated, or mixed reference periods.

sources.title: Digital Standards
sources.what_it_covers: Data governance, data management, exchange, interoperability, and reference architecture.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Normative standards for Pakistan's public-sector digital systems.
sources.limitations: These are normative standards, not measurements of implementation quality or service performance.

sources.title: ITU DataHub — Pakistan
sources.what_it_covers: Connectivity, affordability, markets, governance, trust, and sustainability indicators.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Direct country dashboard for Pakistan.
sources.limitations: Indicators use different source years and may be missing or revised. Always display the indicator-specific period. The page opened in web review but blocks the automated checker with HTTP 403.

sources.title: ICT Development Index 2026
sources.what_it_covers: A composite view of universal and meaningful connectivity across 159 economies.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan is covered in the downloadable economy dataset.
sources.limitations: Confirm the Pakistan row in the downloaded dataset before quoting a score. Methodology changes can affect comparisons.

sources.title: Global Cybersecurity Index 2024
sources.what_it_covers: Legal, technical, organizational, capacity-building, and international-cooperation cybersecurity pillars.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan is included in the global assessment.
sources.limitations: The index measures commitments and maturity, not cyber-incident frequency, losses, or real-world harm.

sources.title: ICT Price Baskets
sources.what_it_covers: Comparable mobile and fixed-broadband price baskets.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan is included in the international price series.
sources.limitations: The basket methodology changed for 2025; affordability also depends on income denominator and package assumptions.

sources.title: G5 Benchmark 2023
sources.what_it_covers: Collaborative digital-regulation governance across policy, institutional, process, and stakeholder pillars.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan pillar values and 2021/2023 comparisons are included.
sources.limitations: This is a composite governance benchmark, not a substitute for current legal texts or implementation evidence.

sources.title: GovTech Maturity Index
sources.what_it_covers: Core government systems, online public services, digital citizen engagement, and GovTech enablers.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan is included within the 198-economy dataset.
sources.limitations: Recent editions are largely self-reported. The World Bank says the index is not a ranking or a performance or readiness score.

sources.title: Global Findex Download Centre
sources.what_it_covers: Mobile ownership, internet use, digital safety, financial access, and digital payments at household and individual level.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan observations are available across several survey rounds.
sources.limitations: The publication year and survey reference year differ, and all household estimates are subject to sampling error.

sources.title: Identification for Development Global Dataset
sources.what_it_covers: Identification ownership, use, barriers, and national identification-system availability.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan is covered by demand- and supply-side evidence.
sources.limitations: Identification possession does not establish that systems are secure, inclusive, accessible, or effectively used. The page opened in web review but blocks the automated checker with HTTP 403.

sources.title: United Nations E-Government Survey 2024
sources.publisher: United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs
sources.what_it_covers: E-government development, online services, telecom infrastructure, human capital, and e-participation.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan is included among all 193 United Nations Member States.
sources.limitations: Composite components use different underlying years and sources, so the headline score is not a single-period measurement.

sources.title: UNCTADstat Pakistan General Profile
sources.publisher: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development
sources.what_it_covers: Country indicators including information-economy and services-trade measures.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Direct Pakistan country profile.
sources.limitations: This is a broad profile; individual values may be estimates, use different reference years, or be unavailable.

sources.title: Global Cyberlaw Tracker
sources.publisher: United Nations Conference on Trade and Development
sources.what_it_covers: Adoption status for electronic-transactions, privacy and data-protection, cybercrime, and online-consumer-protection legislation.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan legal-status entries are included in the global tracker.
sources.limitations: The tracker records adoption or status, not enforcement or effectiveness, and updates may lag legal changes. The page opened in web review but blocks the automated checker with HTTP 403.

sources.title: Global Innovation Index — Pakistan
sources.what_it_covers: Around 80 innovation input and output indicators, rankings, strengths, weaknesses, and trends.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Direct Pakistan country profile.
sources.limitations: Indicator years vary, and rank changes can reflect data availability, comparator movement, and model revisions.

sources.title: Digitally Delivered Services Trade Dataset
sources.what_it_covers: Estimated exports and imports of digitally delivered services across eight subsectors.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan-comparable annual trade estimates.
sources.limitations: The estimates are modelled and allocated; they are not transaction-level observations.

sources.title: Science, Technology and Innovation Data Browser
sources.what_it_covers: Research and development expenditure, researchers, and Sustainable Development Goal 9.5 indicators.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan can be selected where a given indicator and reference year are available.
sources.limitations: Availability and reference year vary by indicator. Never display missing observations as zero.

sources.title: Financial Access Survey
sources.what_it_covers: Supply-side financial access, financial-service infrastructure, and selected digital-finance indicators.
sources.pakistan_coverage: Pakistan-comparable reporting is available within the international dataset.
sources.limitations: Reporting coverage varies, and accounts or access points are not unique users. The page opened in web review but blocks the automated checker with HTTP 403.
